name: Golnir Bouldertoe
summary: At Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe supplies miners and prospectors and receives dispatches from outposts.

sections.title: Merchant of the Great Forge
sections.body: Golnir Bouldertoe outfits prospectors and craftsmen at Ironforge's Great Forge. He sells mining picks, flux, and coal for the smelting fires and smithies of the dwarven capital. Kin to Geofram Bouldertoe, Golnir is a trusted contact for workers arriving in the city. He guides fresh hands and receives supply messages from nearby outposts.

faq.q: Where can I find Golnir Bouldertoe?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe works in Ironforge's Great Forge, near the central smelting and blacksmithing areas with other trade merchants.
Golnir sells mining picks, coal, and flux to prospectors who dig and refine raw ore.

faq.q: Is Golnir Bouldertoe involved in any quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Couriers carry messages from nearby dwarven settlements to the capital. Travelers bring dispatches from outposts such as Thelsamar, including messages linked to Gryth Thurden and incoming flights, directly to Golnir.

faq.q: Is Golnir related to anyone else in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Golnir shares his clan name with Geofram Bouldertoe, a mining trainer who works beside him in Ironforge's Great Forge.

angles.text: Miners at the Great Forge rely on Golnir for tools of their craft, including spare picks and flux to smelt raw vein-work into refined bars.
For dwarves returning from their first journeys out in Coldridge or Kharanos, Golnir is an early contact in the capital. He welcomes travelers beside the mountain's fiery heart.
